subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly with China Southern Airlines via Guangzhou to Kunming and travel through Yunnan in a private bus: Stone Forest, Dali, Lijiang with Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, Tiger Leaping Gorge and Shangri-La. You stay in 5-star hotels and return from Dali to Kunming by high-speed train. This is a no-shopping package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 9–16 2026 to Mar 22–29 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Stone Forest: A landscape of tall grey limestone pillars near Kunming, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
placeDesc.Yi People Ancient Town: A town in Chuxiong that showcases the culture and architecture of the Yi people.
placeDesc.Dali Santorini: A whitewashed, Greek-style viewpoint area overlooking Erhai Lake, visited with afternoon tea.
placeDesc.Black Dragon Pool: A park in Lijiang with a pool that reflects Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
placeDesc.Lijiang Ancient Town: A UNESCO World Heritage old town of canals, cobbled lanes and wooden houses.
placeDesc.Sifang Street: The central square and market street of Lijiang Ancient Town, lively with shops and food stalls.
placeDesc.Jade Dragon Snow Mountain: A snow-capped mountain range near Lijiang, visited at the Glacier Park by ropeway.
placeDesc.Ganhaizi: A high meadow at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain with wide mountain views.
placeDesc.Impression Lijiang: A live song and dance show performed outdoors beneath Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
placeDesc.Baishui River: A mountain stream near Lijiang with pale blue pools, visited together with Blue Moon Valley.
placeDesc.Blue Moon Valley: A scenic valley of turquoise pools below Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, reached by battery car.
placeDesc.Yushui Village: A traditional Naxi village near Lijiang at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
placeDesc.Tiger Leaping Gorge: A deep Yangtze River gorge on the road to Shangri-La, reached with round-trip hand escalators.
placeDesc.Napa Sea: A seasonal grassland lake near Shangri-La; the tour includes one complimentary cup of coffee here.
placeDesc.Dukezong Ancient City: The old Tibetan-style town centre of Shangri-La, home to a giant prayer wheel.
placeDesc.Guishan Park: A hilltop park above Dukezong Ancient City in Shangri-La with a very large prayer wheel.
placeDesc.Songzanlin Monastery: A large Tibetan Buddhist monastery near Shangri-La, visited with a shuttle cart included.
placeDesc.Dali Ancient City: A walled old town beside Erhai Lake and the Cangshan mountains, in Yunnan.
placeDesc.Heilongtan Park: A park in Kunming with a lake and gardens, known for pear blossoms and azaleas from mid-March to mid-April.
placeDesc.Qianwang Old Street: A restored old street in Kunming, visited on the Kunming city walk.
